changelog.body:
# DiscordAutoTranslate 1.1.0

## ✨ 新功能
 - feat: support OpenAI Responses SSE streaming
 - feat: add project log control and document config-only hook adaptation

## 🐛 修复
 - fix: inset settings viewport below native action bar

## ⚙️ 改进与优化

## 📦 其他
 - chore(release): 4-1.1.0
 - docs: align protocol guarantees, cleanup metadata and CI guidance
 - Exercise shared Embed registration and private shadow teardown
 - Retain live native cleanup bindings and clear private shadow spans
 - Use shared public hash API and valid API-test completion fixture
 - Fix audited runtime, rendering, protocol and settings defects
 - test: disambiguate Responses cancellation signal
 - docs: add Discord version download links
 - docs: keep README focused on user-facing guidance
 - Detect translatable prose without vetoing retained code or dense native nodes
 - Compare poll fixture metadata through Android-compatible JSON APIs
 - Enable Discord 340013 polls through the shared native binding profile
 - Use explicit fixture accessor mappings for both reply profiles
 - Unify Discord 340013 reply previews with canonical translation consumers
 - Restore Discord 340013 exact identity click and refresh metadata
 - Make incomplete lifecycle terminal and update strict anchor rejection
 - Remove silent output repair and unify hook cleanup ownership
 - Preserve list source newlines before retained anchors
 - Unify occurrence anchors for every retained native leaf
 - Mark link display spans and diagnose line alignment runs
 - Harden marker validation and preserve detection boundaries
 - Preserve inline-code occurrence boundaries with strict anchors
 - Correct heading list fixture generic types
 - Capture logical heading boundaries for richtext alignment
 - Diagnose ambiguous richtext boundaries from captured structure
 - Align richtext slots using captured source newline boundaries
 - Classify strict richtext replacement rejections without logging content
 - Distinguish response failures from native render rejection
 - Remove obsolete entrypoints, duplicate state and unused build resources
 - Fix disconnect latch shadowing in transport regression tests
 - Remove obsolete standalone text segment counter
 - Unify richtext occurrence plans and request-scoped streaming transport
 - Unify task ownership, bounded scheduling and runtime configuration lifecycles
 - Switch entire Poll card from a single title translation control
 - Translate Discord 352017 Poll through scoped native text writes
 - Adapt Discord 352017 rich Embed native binding
 - Validate reload loader and preserve failed settings transactions
 - Remove legacy fallback paths and completed diagnostics
 - Flatten translated reply line breaks before native margins
 - Trace reply whitespace and guard stale content retries
 - Render reply projections from canonical message translations
 - Diagnose attachment reply state and native ellipsis
 - Preserve native reply rendering and resolve exact content getters
 - Reuse cached cited translations in previews
 - Reuse cited message translation and trace preview overlap
 - Reuse canonical reply translation state
 - Diagnose reply reference binding outcomes
 - Trace reply preview translation and layout
 - Reflow translated reply previews
 - Translate reply previews from bound display text
 - Translate plain-text system reply previews
 - Keep reply previews bound to referenced message
 - Route reply previews through shared translation state
 - Map both reply preview content branches
 - Use semantic getter for referenced message ID
 - Map reply preview system content
 - Map reply content before conversion
 - Use shared render path for reply translations
 - Fix duplicate reply hook method
 - Enable verified reply translation hook
 - Handle unmapped message nodes safely
 - Trace configured message node types
 - Map opaque fixture in factory tests
 - Configure content node test fixtures explicitly
 - Remove implicit reflection name fallbacks
 - Use one configured row refresh path
 - Restore attached holder resolution path
 - Remove holder lookup compatibility scan
 - Use one profile-selected reflection path
 - Keep Kotlin data class handling profile independent
 - Return parsed icon click config directly
 - Make hook behavior configuration driven
 - Remove duplicate layout depth declaration
 - Fix RecyclerView profile helper scope
 - Move RecyclerView refresh metadata into profiles
 - Consume verified Discord RecyclerView updates
 - Retry row layout after pending pre-draw request
 - Trace RecyclerView state after layout traversal
 - Trace RecyclerView layout deferral state
 - Clear verified Discord content holder bind cache
 - Fix rerender diagnostic view reference
 - Trace row refresh layout dimensions
 - Trace translation result and render replacement
 - Refresh RecyclerView through host observable
 - Resolve holders from RecyclerView layout params
 - Resolve outer chat recycler structurally
 - Remeasure message containers after translation
 - Use public RecyclerView APIs for row refresh
 - Find attached RecyclerView holder for relayout
 - Keep icon click span off final text character
 - Resolve 340013 content holder through item view
 - Fallback to direct relayout when row lookup fails
 - Fix 352017 translation icon click span
 - Bind 352017 content from render model ID
 - Trace Discord text conversion callers
 - Use message manager binding hook for 352017
 - Hook the Discord message content view binder
 - Resolve Discord body views to message identity
 - Route hook diagnostics to LSPosed log
 - Mirror lifecycle diagnostics to LSPosed log
 - Trace module lifecycle callbacks
 - Add 352017 runtime hook diagnostics
 - Review versioned hook configuration
 - Simplify project collaboration rules
 - Limit constructor fallback to configured nodes
 - Add versioned Discord hook profiles
 - 更新 README.md

基于 `main` 最新代码构建，versionCode 4。

changelog.name: DiscordAutoTranslate 1.0.1
changelog.body:
# DiscordAutoTranslate 1.0.1

## ✨ 新功能
 - feat: use vector artwork as app icon
 - feat: localize settings by system language
 - feat: translate multilingual Discord messages
 - feat: add configurable streaming requests

## 🐛 修复
 - fix(release): correct changelog range for detached release tags
 - fix: reduce launcher artwork size
 - fix: enlarge transparent launcher artwork
 - fix: use transparent Discord icon artwork
 - fix: use reference artwork for app icon
 - fix: restore config sync generation guard
 - fix: save settings before module activation
 - fix: allow non-view rerender targets
 - fix: emoji 锚点丢失时降级对齐，不再整条拒译

## ⚙️ 改进与优化
 - perf: compress launcher icon asset
 - refactor: enforce single translation paths
 - refactor: 合并 emoji 锚点对齐路径

## 📦 其他
 - chore(release): 3-1.0.1
 - ci: sync stable releases to LSPosed module repo
 - ui: select target language from dropdown
 - test: align strict mapping expectations
 - test: import strict alignment assertion
 - test: 补 assertNull 导入
 - test: 断言保留原文节点前导空格；严格化丢锚点断言
 - test: 修正实例比较 bug（同一节点树引用）
 - test: 复现角色提及+标题+自定义emoji消息保持英文（记录当前行为）

基于 `main` 最新代码构建，versionCode 3。

changelog.name: DiscordAutoTranslate 1.0.0
changelog.body:
Discord 消息自动翻译（英文 → 简体中文）模块 1.0.0 正式版。

- 基于 LibXposed API 102，适用于 LSPosed
- 保留 Markdown 结构翻译、行内三态图标、回复引用/Embed/投票翻译
- 支持 OpenAI-Compatible / OpenAI-Responses / Anthropic Messages 与 SSE
- APK 已签名（证书 CN=DiscordAutoTranslate, O=wxmyyds）

# Discord AutoTranslate **LSPosed module for translating Discord messages** [Latest module APK](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases/latest) · [Source code](https://github.com/wxmyyds/DiscordAutoTranslate) · [中文](#简体中文) | [English](#english)
--- ## 简体中文 这是一个面向 Discord Android 的 LSPosed 模块。它通过你配置的翻译服务翻译消息，并尽量保留 Discord 原有的富文本结构。 ### 下载 | 项目 | 下载 | |---|---| | 模块 APK | [本仓库最新 Release](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases/latest) | | Discord 340.13 Stable（versionCode 340013）| [下载 Discord APK](https://1drv.ms/u/c/8ccaf25c5b0de4fb/IQC_FsEpTW9pQYQTZZX4XrKJAUecfhaG98Q7V0cyTK1MIqg?e=QTqag5) | | Discord 352.17 Stable（versionCode 352017）| [下载 Discord APK](https://1drv.ms/u/c/8ccaf25c5b0de4fb/IQCbMILHoJWrQYp5eeZrkUTAAT85sbCHsOEhamnOonbWzCg?e=qh9gUL) | ### 功能概览 - 翻译消息正文，并提供原文／译文切换；失败时可手动重试。 - 尽可能保留 Markdown、链接、表情、提及和代码等宿主结构；无法安全回填时保留原文。 - 支持回复预览、富 Embed 和投票内容翻译。 - 支持 OpenAI Compatible、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 协议，以及设置页中的配置检查和翻译测试。 ### 安装 1. 从本仓库的 [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases/latest) 下载并安装**模块 APK**。 2. 打开模块设置，配置翻译服务地址、密钥、模型和目标语言，然后保存。 3. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块，并将 `com.discord` 加入作用域。 4. 强制停止并重新启动 Discord。 要求 Android 8.0（API 26）或更新版本，以及支持 LibXposed API 102 的 LSPosed。模块设置可以在启用模块前填写；LSPosed 服务可用后会同步设置。 ### 隐私与免责声明 消息的可翻译内容会发送到你配置的翻译服务。请确认该服务符合你的隐私要求；不要在不可信的翻译服务中使用敏感消息。本模块不是 Discord 官方产品，与 Discord Inc. 无关联。Discord 为其商标；使用本模块或第三方客户端安装包可能违反 Discord 服务条款，请自行评估风险。 --- ## English Discord AutoTranslate is an LSPosed module for Discord on Android. It sends translatable message content to the translation service you configure and preserves Discord's rich-text structure where it can do so safely. ### Downloads | Item | Download | |---|---| | Module APK | [Latest release in this repository](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases/latest) | | Discord 340.13 Stable (`versionCode` 340013) | [Download Discord APK](https://1drv.ms/u/c/8ccaf25c5b0de4fb/IQC_FsEpTW9pQYQTZZX4XrKJAUecfhaG98Q7V0cyTK1MIqg?e=QTqag5) | | Discord 352.17 Stable (`versionCode` 352017) | [Download Discord APK](https://1drv.ms/u/c/8ccaf25c5b0de4fb/IQCbMILHoJWrQYp5eeZrkUTAAT85sbCHsOEhamnOonbWzCg?e=qh9gUL) | ### Features - Translate message bodies with an original/translation toggle and manual retry on failure. - Preserve Markdown, links, emoji, mentions, and code where safe; keep the original text when a translation cannot be mapped safely. - Translate reply previews, rich embeds, and poll content. - Supports OpenAI Compatible, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages, with configuration and translation tests in the settings screen. ### Installation 1. Download and install the **module APK** from this repository's [latest release](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.wxmyyds.discordautotranslate/releases/latest). 2. Open module settings, configure your translation endpoint, API key, model, and target language, then save. 3. Enable the module in LSPosed and add `com.discord` to its scope. 4. Force-stop and restart Discord. Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or later and LSPosed with LibXposed API 102 support. Settings may be entered before enabling the module and are synchronized when the LSPosed service becomes available. ### Privacy and disclaimer Translatable message content is sent to the translation service you configure. Review that service's privacy practices and do not use an untrusted service for sensitive messages. This is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with Discord Inc. Discord is a trademark of Discord Inc. Use of this module or third-party client APKs may violate Discord's Terms of Service; use them at your own discretion.
